ox.services.faq_1_a: A written question is free and a branch visit is free. The 20-minute video consultation has a price shown on its own page.
ox.services.faq_2_q: What should I bring to the call or the visit?
ox.services.faq_2_a: Your goal, how many days a week you train, the names of what you use now, and your question in writing. If the visit is to collect an order, bring the order number.
ox.services.faq_3_q: Am I committed to buying after I ask?

ox.pages.about.lead: OptimalX is a new supplement and sports nutrition store. It started in Madinah with one branch in Al Khalidiyah on Jabbar bin Sakhr Street, and it ships to every city in Saudi Arabia.
ox.pages.about.story_1: We are two partners who train like you do. We have bought supplements we did not need, because nobody explained the difference between one product and another. That is where the store came from: a place that explains before it sells.
ox.pages.about.story_2: What we do: we stock a small range we know and can explain. Every product carries its serving count, its serving size and its expiry date, and the nutrition table gets a third column that says what each number means. We answer your written questions ourselves.
ox.pages.about.story_3: What we do not do: we do not diagnose, read lab results, promise outcomes or write diet plans. We help you pick a supplement that fits your goal and use it the way the label says, and that is the limit of our work.
ox.pages.about.story_4: The store is new. We have no reviews and no sales figures to show yet, and we will not invent them. What we have is a branch with a real address, authentic products with a clear expiry date, and time to answer your question.
ox.pages.about.why_1_body: Every product carries its serving count, serving size and expiry date. The nutrition table has a third column that says what each number means.
ox.pages.about.why_2_title: A chosen range, not a warehouse
ox.pages.about.why_2_body: We stock products we know and can explain. We do not add a product just because it is trending.
ox.pages.about.why_3_title: We say what is outside our work
ox.pages.about.why_3_body: We do not diagnose and we do not promise outcomes. We help you pick a supplement that fits your goal, and that is all we do.
ox.pages.about.why_4_body: We started in Al Khalidiyah with one branch and a team of two. We ship across Saudi Arabia and answer your questions ourselves.

ox.services.nutrition.title: Nutrition and supplements: where to start
ox.services.nutrition.subline: We do not write diets and we do not read lab results. We help you choose a supplement that sits alongside the food you already eat, and use it the way the label says.
ox.services.nutrition.intro: A supplement is called a supplement because it completes food that is already there; it does not replace it. In the video consultation we go through your goal, how many days a week you train, your budget and what you eat on an ordinary day, then suggest one or two products in priority order and explain the dose printed on the label. We do not set a meal schedule, we do not count calories, and we do not put a number on a weight or a body fat figure.
ox.services.nutrition.scope_1: Choosing a supplement that fits the food you eat and your goal
ox.services.nutrition.scope_2: Putting two or three products in priority order
ox.services.nutrition.scope_3: The dose and the timing exactly as printed on the label
ox.services.nutrition.scope_4: Reading the nutrition facts panel and the ingredients
ox.services.nutrition.prepare: Your goal, how many days a week you train, roughly what you eat on an ordinary day, and the names of what you use now.
ox.services.nutrition.output: A written list of one or two products in priority order, with the dose printed on the label.
ox.services.nutrition.footer: This is not a diet plan and it is not health advice. We do not write diets and we do not read lab results.
